title: Governance
user_action: Read and vote on MycoDAO proposals in Realms with MYCO.
note: The realm exists. Voting rules and a recorded vote still need to be checked (task M13).

title: Contributor rewards
user_action: Submit an observation against a MINDEX taxon. Approved observations can earn that species' token, or MYCO for eligible new or rare records.
note: Runs on Solana devnet. Test tokens have no mainnet value.

title: Pay for biobank services
user_action: Pay in MYCO for culture storage or a tissue sample.
note: Not available yet. No order or fulfillment path exists.

title: Support a documented project need
user_action: Contribute MYCO to a named project need and follow the result.
note: Proposed pilot: one Project Oyster sequencing batch. Not open until the recipient, budget and terms are set.

title: Commercial rights
note: Holding MYCO gives no royalty, revenue or ownership rights. Any licensing would be under a named agreement.
